en: **Four Sigmatic** — Target assortment
Coffee plus Focus, Calm and Memory capsules; Focus combines lion’s mane, L-theanine and vitamin B12.[5]
Target assortment; a Focus instant-coffee listing at Whole Foods.[22]
One brand can serve both a daily beverage task and a supplement task.
**RYZE** — Mushroom Coffee
SUPER6 blend with coffee; energy, focus and gut-health positioning.[6]
Brand website, with direct consumer shipping described.[6]
The blend supports a repeatable drinking ritual rather than a single-species identity.
**Real Mushrooms** — Lion’s Mane Capsules
Fruiting-body, hot-water extract; the brand states more than 30% beta-glucans.[7]
Brand webshop.[7]
Material identity and stated constituent content become visible product differentiators.
**FreshCap** — Ultimate Mushroom Complex Powder
Multi-mushroom extract powder; ingredient panel lists a six-mushroom blend and standardized beta-glucan content.[8]
Direct sales and automatic-delivery subscription.[8]
Convenience and material detail combine with replenishment marketing.
**Host Defense** — Lion’s Mane Capsules
Explicit “Powered by Mushroom Mycelium” positioning.[9]
Brand webshop, including subscription on larger sizes.[9]
A mycelium proposition competes on a different material narrative from fruiting-body-only extracts.
**Om Mushroom Superfood** — Master Blend Gummies
Ten mushrooms plus KSM-66 ashwagandha; the brand describes a full-spectrum approach using mycelium, primordia and/or fruit bodies.[10]
Brand webshop.[10]
Chewable convenience and a multi-ingredient wellness proposition broaden the format choice.
**Odyssey** — Functional Energy
Ready-to-drink lion’s mane and cordyceps combinations; distinct caffeine lines.[11]
Brand webshop; historical trade reporting describes natural retail, direct-store delivery and wholesale distribution.[15]
The product competes as an energy drink, making distribution and inventory execution central.
zh: **Four Sigmatic**：Target产品组合
咖啡与Focus、Calm、Memory胶囊；Focus结合猴头菇、茶氨酸和维生素B12。[5]
Target产品组合；Whole Foods也有Focus速溶咖啡商品页。[22]
同一品牌分别服务日常饮用和营养补充任务。
**RYZE**：Mushroom Coffee
SUPER6混合物搭配咖啡，以能量、专注和肠道健康构建定位。[6]
官网销售，介绍直接发货给消费者的方式。[6]
以重复饮用习惯承载混合配方，而非突出单一菌种。
**Real Mushrooms**：猴头菇胶囊
子实体热水提取物，品牌标示β-葡聚糖超过30%。[7]
品牌官网商店。[7]
材料身份与成分含量直接成为产品卖点。
**FreshCap**：Ultimate Mushroom Complex粉末
多菌提取粉，配料栏列出六菌混合物及标准化β-葡聚糖含量。[8]
官网直销及自动配送订阅。[8]
将使用便利、材料信息与定期补货结合。
**Host Defense**：猴头菇胶囊
明确采用“Powered by Mushroom Mycelium”菌丝体定位。[9]
官网商店，较大瓶型提供订阅。[9]
菌丝体路线与仅用子实体的提取物形成不同材料叙事。
**Om Mushroom Superfood**：Master Blend软糖
十种蘑菇与KSM-66南非醉茄；品牌介绍使用菌丝体、原基和/或子实体的全谱路线。[10]
品牌官网商店。[10]
咀嚼便利性与多成分日常健康定位拓宽形态选择。
**Odyssey**：Functional Energy
猴头菇与虫草即饮复配，设置不同咖啡因系列。[11]
官网销售；历史行业报道介绍自然零售、门店直配及批发分销。[15]
以能量饮料身份竞争，分销和库存执行成为关键。
